q0818: Testers get no inside information and the defenders aren't told = unknown environment (black box).
q0819: Threat or scam delivered by text message = smishing.
q0820: Fake text from 'the CEO' = smishing (the channel) + impersonation (the disguise).
q0821: 'Ensure ALL devices are patched' → you need a complete asset inventory first.
q0822: Phishing through a QR code (a 2D matrix barcode) = quishing.
q0823: Cheap, unvetted IoT hardware → counterfeit or tampered products (supply chain risk).
q0824: Containment/eradication: identify the threat, then remove it. Restoring systems is recovery.
q0825: Check a device's posture (patches, AV) before it gets network access = NAC.
q0826: Undervoltage/brownout or outage → UPS. A surge protector only handles overvoltage spikes.
q0827: User asks for all their data to be deleted = right to be forgotten (GDPR right to erasure).
q0829: Phone's OS restrictions removed so it boots something else with admin rights = jailbreaking (rooting on Android).
q0830: Two different cloud providers so one failure doesn't take everything down = platform diversity.
q0831: PLCs + unencrypted industrial protocols (Modbus, DNP3) = SCADA/ICS.
q0832: Secure connectivity between two companies' networks = site-to-site VPN.
q0833: Scan the source code before it runs or ships = static analysis (SAST). Dynamic tests the running app.
q0834: CSPM finds too many misconfigurations → guardrails enforce the secure baseline at deployment.
q0835: Look-alike URL registered to catch typos = typosquatting.
q0836: Layoffs + insider risk + awareness team → train managers to spot and handle disgruntled staff.
q0837: Rank vulnerability scan results quickly by severity = CVSS scores.
q0838: Gathering public info without probing the target (browsing, downloading the website) = passive reconnaissance.
q0839: Trust another organization's authentication (their IdP/LDAP) = federation.
q0840: Outdated OS + malware infections → review patching first.
q0841: End-of-life equipment → decommission (remove from service, sanitize, update inventory) before disposal.
q0842: Fewer false positives for analysts to review by hand → SOAR playbooks auto-triage alerts.
q0843: Public breach report → customers lose trust = reputational damage.
q0844: Proof that a vendor destroyed your media = certificate of destruction (certification).
q0845: After remediating, prove the fix worked = rescan.
q0846: Find ANY possible issue, cost no object → bug bounty (many outside researchers).
q0847: Classified secrets handed to a hostile organization = espionage.
